rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for someone who reliably fulfills their duties.

example.english: They are always dutiful at work, so no one worries about tasks assigned to them.
example.traditional: 佢做嘢一向好盡責，交畀佢嘅工作從來唔使人擔心。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zou6 je5 jat1 hoeng3 hou2 zeon6 zaak3 gaau1 bei2 keoi5 ge3 gung1 zok3 cung4 loi4 m4 sai2 jan4 daam1 sam1

rows.note: Use this especially for a child who obeys instructions and does what they are expected to do.

example.english: The boy is very dutiful and takes his medicine as soon as we ask.
example.traditional: 個仔好聽話，叫佢食藥就即刻食。
example.jyutping: go3 zai2 hou2 teng1 waa6 giu3 keoi5 sik6 joek6 zau6 zik1 hak1 sik6

rows.note: Use this when stressing that someone carries out duties tirelessly and without complaint.

example.english: For years, Mum has been dutiful, quietly caring for the whole family.
example.traditional: 媽媽多年來任勞任怨，默默照顧全家。
example.jyutping: maa1 maa1 do1 nin4 loi4 jam6 lou4 jam6 jyun3 mak6 mak6 ziu3 gu3 cyun4 gaa1
